home.howItWorksSubtitle: The real steps, from creating your account to finishing your sessions

steps.title: Create Your Account and Complete Your Academic Profile
items: Register directly with your name, email, phone number, and password
Choose your education type — school, university, or training courses — and complete its details (curriculum and grade, or university and major, or course field)
If you're a minor, you can add a guardian's details during registration

steps.title: Browse Teachers and Pick the Right One
items: Search and filter results by subject, curriculum, grade, language, and price
Open a teacher's full profile: their bio, intro videos, and past students' reviews
Compare the packages offered by more than one teacher before choosing

steps.title: Choose a Package and Send a Booking Request
items: Choose an individual or group package from the teacher's profile
For individual packages, pick the day and time from the teacher's availability (in half-hour slots)
Enter a discount code if you have one before sending the request

steps.title: Wait for the Teacher's Approval
items: Your request shows as "awaiting teacher approval" until they review it
You get an instant notification when it's approved or declined
If declined, you can pick another time or another teacher right away, at no cost

steps.title: Complete Payment Securely
items: Once the teacher approves, you're asked to complete payment through a secure gateway within a set window
If payment isn't completed in time, the booking is cancelled automatically and you can try again
Review all your payments and invoices anytime from the "Invoices" page in your dashboard

steps.title: Attend Your Sessions
items: Track all your upcoming sessions from the calendar and the "Sessions" page
You can join the session room up to five minutes before it starts
You get reminders ahead of every session

steps.title: Rate and Track Your Progress
items: After every session you can rate your teacher and write a review that helps other students
Keep track of your progress and your teacher's feedback over time
Review all your past ratings from the "Reviews" page

steps.title: Extra Academic Support
items: University students can browse academic supporters specialized in their field
Subscribe to a support package covering one or more subjects, at a price the supporter sets themselves
Enter a discount code if you have one when subscribing, before paying

stepsTeacher.title: Receiving Your Invitation
items: Teachers don't self-register — the Ta'alam team creates your account after an initial contact and assessment
You receive an email invitation with an activation link, or a temporary password to log in directly
On first login your account status is "unverified" until your profile and documents are complete

stepsTeacher.title: Completing Your Profile
items: Add your photo and a clear bio describing yourself and your teaching style
Set your qualification, years of experience, and the subjects, curricula, and languages you teach
Add a short intro video to help students get to know you before booking (optional, but it boosts your chances of being chosen)

stepsTeacher.title: Uploading Verification Documents
items: Proof of identity, an academic certificate, and proof of experience — three required documents your profile can't be complete without
You can add optional documents, such as a professional certificate, to strengthen your profile
You can't submit your profile for review before uploading the three required documents and writing your bio

stepsTeacher.title: Review and Verification
items: The quality team reviews your profile and documents shortly after submission
On approval your account becomes "verified", a verified badge appears on your public profile for students — and you're ready to actually start teaching
On rejection you get a message explaining exactly why, with the option to edit your details or re-upload the rejected documents

stepsTeacher.title: Setting Your Availability
items: Set the days and hours you're available each week from the settings page
This availability is the basis your individual packages are built on later
You can update your availability anytime without affecting bookings already confirmed

stepsTeacher.title: Creating Lesson Packages
items: Individual package: you set the days it's available within your general availability, and the student picks the day and time when booking
Group package: you set the date and time of the first session and the allowed student capacity, and sessions repeat weekly automatically
Set the subject, curriculum, grade, number of sessions, and price, and you can add a discount percentage
Every package is sent for admin review before it becomes visible and bookable by students

stepsTeacher.title: Receiving and Approving Booking Requests
items: You get an instant notification whenever a student sends a booking request on one of your packages
Review the request from the "Booking Requests" page, and approve or decline it with an optional reason
Once you approve, the student is asked to complete payment within a set window to finalize the booking

stepsTeacher.title: Running Sessions and Tracking Your Schedule
items: Track all your upcoming bookings from the calendar, and every session's details from the "Sessions" page
You can join the session room up to five minutes before it starts
Track the list of students enrolled with you and their progress from the "Students" page

stepsTeacher.title: Tracking Your Earnings
items: Your earnings are calculated automatically from every fully-paid session or package
Review your earnings and payment details from the invoices page in your dashboard
You can create discount coupons for your packages to attract new students when needed

about.heroSubtitle1: Ta'alam isn't just a link between a student and a teacher that ends the moment you book
about.heroSubtitle2: It's a system built to protect you at every step, from choosing your teacher to your last session
about.storyP1: Every student has felt this: sitting alone in front of a lesson that just won't click, reading it again and again while the clock keeps moving and the worry grows faster than any understanding. And every parent has felt the same worry from the other side — searching for a teacher who actually understands their child, not just a name on a long list, trying one teacher after another, losing time and money, left with one question hanging over everything: who will actually reach my child?
about.storyP2: Ta'alam was born from that exact pain. We didn't want to be one more platform that lists teacher names and leaves the choice to luck. We wanted a place where every parent can trust their child is in genuinely reliable hands, and every student finally feels that someone understood them and stayed patient until the idea landed.
about.manifestoTitle: We're not like any other platform
about.manifestoText: We don't just list teacher names and leave your choice to luck. Every teacher goes through a real document review before ever appearing to a student, and no booking is confirmed until your teacher personally approves your time — no surprises, no waiting without an answer.
about.differenceSubtitle: Not slogans — these are actual details you'll find inside the platform, not just on a marketing page

difference.them: A "verified teacher" badge is granted automatically on signup
difference.us: Real verification through 3 required documents — proof of identity, an academic certificate, and proof of experience — manually reviewed by a dedicated team before any teacher appears to students

difference.them: You book and pay instantly, then find out the time doesn't actually work for your teacher
difference.us: Your booking isn't confirmed and you're never asked to pay until your teacher personally approves your time

difference.them: Academic support and private tutoring are one blurry, undefined mix
difference.us: "Academic Support" is a fully separate entity, built for university students, staffed by real academic specialists — not school teachers

difference.them: You join right at the exact minute or lose part of your time
difference.us: You can enter the session room a full five minutes before it starts

difference.them: Pricing and package details sometimes only show up after you've booked
difference.us: You see the package's name, full contents, and price before committing to anything, and you enter any discount code yourself

about.visionText: That finding a trustworthy teacher should never be a matter of luck or who you know, anywhere in the region
about.missionText: We verify every teacher carefully, so you can trust easily
